entities.name: Service Gap Control
entities.description: Network mechanism to control frequency of UE transitions from EMM-IDLE to EMM-CONNECTED mode by imposing service gaps.

entities.name: Service Gap Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer used to enforce service gap periods, started when NAS signalling connection is released and running during service gap control.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered but has no active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: EMM state where UE has an active NAS signalling connection with the network.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is not registered with the network.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to initiate attach procedure, indicates SGC support.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to initiate tracking area update procedure, indicates SGC support.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to accept attach request, contains T3447 value.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to accept tracking area update request, contains T3447 value.

entities.name: SGC Active Condition
entities.description: Condition where network supports SGC and service gap time value is available in UE EMM context.

entities.name: T3447 Start Condition (UE)
entities.description: UE starts T3447 when NAS signalling connection is released, UE supports SGC, and timer value is available and non-zero.

entities.name: T3447 Start Condition (Network)
entities.description: Network starts T3447 when UE transitions from EMM-CONNECTED to EMM-IDLE mode, except for specific request types.

entities.name: Allowed Requests During T3447
entities.description: Network allows specific requests when T3447 is running: emergency bearer services, exception data reporting, attach without PDN connection, TA update without active flags, high priority access, and mobile terminated services.

relations.description: Service Gap Control procedure involves starting and managing timer T3447.
Service Gap Control procedure requires SGC to be active in the network.
ATTACH REQUEST message indicates UE support for SGC feature.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message indicates UE support for SGC feature.
ATTACH ACCEPT message contains T3447 timer value for SGC.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains T3447 timer value for SGC.
UE starts T3447 when NAS signalling connection is released and conditions are met.
Network starts T3447 when UE transitions from EMM-CONNECTED to EMM-IDLE mode.
UE transitions from EMM-CONNECTED to EMM-IDLE mode triggers T3447 start.
When T3447 is running, network allows specific types of requests.
T3447 continues running when UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state if UE remains on and USIM unchanged.
